entities.name: Query CTP synthase
observations: 547 aa protein; predicted molecular weight 61.2 kDa and theoretical pI 6.20.
Strong homologs are curated CTP synthases with 64.3–66.5% identity and 96.3–96.7% query coverage.
Contains CTP_synth_N domain at positions 4–268 and GATase domain at positions 304–528.
Reference CTP synthases are homotetramers and catalyze ATP-dependent conversion of UTP to CTP using glutamine or ammonia nitrogen.
Likely participates in de novo pyrimidine metabolism and CTP biosynthesis; exact regulation and oligomerization are inferred from homologs, not directly experimentally tested for this sequence.

entities.name: CTP synthase
observations: Overall reaction: UTP + glutamine + ATP + H2O → CTP + glutamate + ADP + phosphate; ammonia can substitute as nitrogen donor.
Glutaminase module hydrolyzes glutamine to generate ammonia, which is transferred intramolecularly to the UTP-derived intermediate.
Curated homologs are cytosolic homotetramers and are regulated by nucleotide effectors, including GTP activation in glutamine-dependent catalysis and CTP feedback inhibition.

entities.name: De novo CTP biosynthesis
observations: CTP synthase catalyzes the final amidation step converting UTP to CTP in de novo pyrimidine metabolism.
The pathway supplies CTP for RNA synthesis, phospholipid synthesis, and other cytidine nucleotide-dependent processes.
